verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is documented as a terminal-based AI coding agent with a TUI and a headless mode. The evidence pack shows no IDE extension, plugin, or in-editor chat panel. LSP diagnostics and the embeddable TUI are adjacent features, not in-IDE chat, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can chat with the coding assistant directly inside my IDE for contextual help
